name: Baseline Compatibility
research_question: Does the proposed extension strictly preserve original ARF-RT results when evaluating unmodified baseline fixtures without research context metadata?

referenced_baseline_fixtures.description: Diamond scenario with four roles and cross-account SCP constraint
Primary realistic AWS enterprise scenario with 14 nodes and complex topologies

complete_constraint_system: NONE (No research context condition schema present)
formal_rationale: As proven in docs/PHASE15_FORMAL_FEASIBILITY_MODEL.md (§4.2 & §6 CE5), any scenario lacking the research condition schema must evaluate to UNKNOWN feasibility. UNKNOWN feasibility universally assigns a multiplier of 1.0, ensuring that no path scores are altered and search frontier orderings are completely identical to the baseline ARF-RT engine.
falsification_criteria: The backward compatibility invariant is falsified if running the extended pipeline against unmodified diamond_scenario.json or primary_realistic_scenario.json yields any difference in top-K path sequences, rank order, p_worst_q8, or p_best_q8 compared to baseline ARF-RT.
